meta.name: poc
meta.description: Run a bounded customer proof of concept to test a consequential uncertainty. Use for a spike or pilot with a question and decision deadline, not a full rollout.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用小范围试点验证关键疑问,在截止日前做出明确决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对一个代价不小的选择,想先小范围试一把再决定要不要全面投入
copy.tagline_en: Test a key uncertainty with a small pilot and decide by the deadline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face a costly decision and want a small trial before committing

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先读任务上下文契约和 PoC 方法,再围绕一个有决策截止时间的关键不确定性做有边界的验证(可为 spike 或试点),产出支撑决策的结论,而不做全量上线。
howto.when: 当你需要做一次有明确问题与决策截止时间的 spike 或试点时触发,而非全量铺开;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的脱敏信息包与范围。

say.text: 帮我做一次客户 PoC,要验证的问题是X,决策截止时间定在下周五。
say.note: 会先读方法与上下文契约,再开始验证

say.text: 把这个不确定性做成一次 spike,只做到能支撑决策为止。
say.note: 范围收在有边界的验证内

say.text: @fde 已经在跑了,复用它的脱敏信息包和范围,别重新开始。
say.note: 跳过重复的初始化和提问

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the task context contract and the PoC method, then runs a bounded proof of concept (spike or pilot) against one consequential uncertainty with a decision deadline, reporting what supports the decision instead of a full rollout.
howto.when_en: Use when you need a spike or pilot with a question and a decision deadline, not a full rollout; when called by @fde it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Run a customer PoC with me: the question is X, decision deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: It reads the method and context contract first

say_en.text: Turn this uncertainty into a spike, stopping once it can support the decision.
say_en.note: Scope stays inside the bounded test

say_en.text: @fde is already running; reuse its sanitized packet and scope, don't restart.
